title: Gridwit
description: A word-guessing game with a wise-cracking owl. Guess the hidden word as mint, amber and slate tiles show how close you are, across five difficulties from 4-letter Easy to 8-letter Brutal with a timer. Play five Daily words with leaderboards, an endless Gauntlet that gets longer, a 3-minute Rush, Fib mode where one tile in every row lies, and challenge links with your own secret word. Hints, streaks, achievements and unlockable tile themes.
